text:
nina: quick brain-dump — prototype for left rail that groups Models, Deployments, Pipelines under one collapsible 'Models' cluster. added a tiny jumpbar (Recent | Favorites | All) at the top of the cluster. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/placeholder-jumpbar :sparkles:
omar: love the jumpbar idea. main ask: what's our canonical URL scheme so existing alerts/docs don't break?
chris: sketch of URL contract:
- list: /orgs/:org/projects/:proj/models
- model overview: /orgs/:org/projects/:proj/models/:modelId
- nested resource canonical: /orgs/:org/projects/:proj/models/:modelId/deployments/:depId/runs/:runId
- use query/hash only for transient UI state (open drawer, filter toggles)
rachel: discovery note — if we hide Deployments inside Models, add a persistent 'Jump: Deployments' pill in the jumpbar for orgs with >10 deployments. otherwise people will DM SRE. :grimacing:
chris: agree. implementation: server redirects for legacy paths -> canonical for 12 months, client-side mapping table for another 6 months after that. infra-bot: will create redirect ticket.
aria11y: a11y checklist:
- collapsed breadcrumbs must expose full path via aria-label; tooltip alone is not enough
- when landing on a deep link, move focus to the page H1 and set aria-current on the active crumb
- active sidebar contrast must be >= 4.5:1 for small text
- ensure jumpbar pills are keyboard reachable and have clear focus outlines
nina: copy question: label the nav item "Deployments" or "Runs & Deployments"? Data from support shows "runs" is common for self-serve users. propose nav: "Deployments" with secondary microcopy "(runs)" in the expanded view.
omar: telemetry: add counts for legacy route traffic and clicks on collapsed crumbs to decide extension of redirects. chris: add e2e test cases:
- direct open to /orgs/x/projects/y/models/123/deployments/456 -> sidebar highlights Models cluster and expands Deployments, focus to H1
- open with query ?panel=logs -> logs drawer opens, but URL canonical remains the path
- keyboard-only navigation: tab into jumpbar pills, activate a pill, assert focus lands on the correct section
rachel: small UX nit — breadcrumbs get long: collapse middle crumbs after 3 items and show full path on hover. but for pasteable permalinks, always provide a copy icon that copies the full canonical path.
aria11y: screenreader behavior: collapsed crumb should read like "Org > ellipsis > Model > Run" but aria-label must be the full readable path.
nina: i'll update figma and open a tiny RFC. pinging infra to create the redirect ticket and staging preview. 15-min sync tomorrow 10:00am PT?
omar: +1
chris: on calendar. infra-bot: staging deploy scheduled 2026-06-08T04:00:00Z :rocket:
nina: thanks all, will attach the a11y checklist and migration mapping in the PR.
